authorization: User requested missing values be filled with approximations/assumptions and recorded.

evidence.material_factors: Copper 4.0: Copper Information Center, 2023-11-17, 4 tonnes GHG/tonne cathode; Brass: assumed copper proxy (no actual alloy composition); Nylon 8.06/POM 3.22/Silicone 2.66: kettle study Annex E, PDF193; PC: assumed nylon proxy, not measured PC factor. All low/high factor ranges +/-30% are analyst-selected.
evidence.steel_yield: assumed 0.90; low-impact 0.98, high-impact 0.75; not measured yield
evidence.other_yield: assumed uniform 0.95 excluding PP; low 0.99/high 0.90; includes packaging procurement loss
evidence.polymer_forming_kWh_kg: proxy from USLCI PP injection 6.444 MJ/kg /3.6 =1.79 kWh/kg, applied to all non-PP polymer finished mass including silicone cure/LDPE conversion as coarse proxy
evidence.electricity_kg_kWh: assumed round screening factor 0.5 kg CO2e/kWh, not a measured or country-specific grid factor
evidence.metal_forming_kWh_kg: assumed 0.5 kWh/kg finished stainless; excludes rolling already included in coil factor
evidence.packaging_kWh: assumed 0.02 kWh/kettle; packaging operation only, cardboard production already counted
evidence.inbound_km: assumed additional supplier-to-kettle-factory distance 500 km; excludes finished-product distribution
evidence.truck_kg_tkm: assumed 0.1 kg CO2e/t-km; not claimed as government dataset
evidence.scrap_kg_kg: assumed average 2 kg CO2e/kg newly modeled manufacturing loss plus PP scrap, no recycling credit; crude mixed waste route
evidence.background_allowance_fraction: assumed 10% of scaled inherited six-material subtotal for unresolved upstream inputs/uncharacterized greenhouse flows. Accounting allowance only, not linked LCI or empirically justified correction. Low0/high30%. Does not fix biogenic-carbon or allocation differences.

range_warning: Analyst-selected stress scenarios, not statistical uncertainty or guaranteed bounds.
